text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the library,
I caught sight of No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho...! I see, I see~ Truly skillful!
choice_data_list: You're taking this really seriously, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, 'tis you.
I was just reading a chronicle of ancient battles.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...You see, lately my training just hasn't felt right at all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It was truly like trying to grasp at clouds,
and I was completely at my wit's end...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I can't quite put it into words, but I suspect the fault lies with me.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I picked up these books
to search for clues.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, this is where it gets really interesting!
Let us read on!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! Making a move like that here?!
To have such broad peripheral vision while in the midst of battle!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No, but in this case,
it would be better to see what the opponent does first—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Could this possibly be...
the Sengoku era!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ――Hah! What in the world was I doing...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I see it now! Diving into battle—
it was that very spirit I was lacking!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I can't just sit around, training starts now! Training is war, I say!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, No Reason's running
looked better than ever.
